profile.name: 罗德与施瓦茨 RTO1024 示波器
profile.description: 一台数字示波器，用于实验中的时域信号采集与波形读取。根据驱动证据，该设备可配置采样率、触发相关的采集时间窗口，并读取通道 1 的波形数据。
profile.description_en: A digital oscilloscope used for time-domain signal acquisition and waveform readout in laboratory experiments. Based on the driver evidence, it can configure sampling rate and trigger-related acquisition windows, and read waveform data from channel 1.
